body.label: Trigger
body.html: An enemy targets you or an ally within 2 units with an Action.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose another eligible creature within 2 units of the original target. The attacker suffers -1 die unless it changes the target to that creature.

surges.html: After the triggering effect resolves, learn whether its source has any unused Reactions or maintained effects.
Draw, conceal, or interact with one small item as part of this Reaction.
